notes: Sheet is turned: north is to the LEFT (Spring Grove Av. across the top, Stock Av. at the left edge, Hopple vertical at the right). Stock Av. (16') leans left going down; it ends at Johnson, where Johnson begins (L-corner, recorded as T; same corner as on sheet 303). AVON PL. (~40 ft, no width printed) leaves the east (top) side of Spring Grove and ends there. Johnson (27') runs from Stock to Hopple and ends at Hopple. Spring Grove/Hopple is the centre of the four corners; the leg south of Hopple is offset ~80 px up (east) because Spring Grove bends there. Hopple continues west past the stockyards and railroad onto an iron bridge over Mill Creek. The stockyard drives and divisions are private and not recorded. Johnson is qualified '(south of Stock)' to keep it apart from the separate Johnson piece north of Alabama (sheets 303, 305).
